name: Marienhafe (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, yellow and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Marienhafe (a yellow harpy above an anchor on red).
history: Municipal flag of Marienhafe; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Marienhafe arms — harpy and anchor on red
